messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the Canadian federal holidays that create “long weekends” in 2023 (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, or are observed on a Monday when they land on a weekend).  

| Date | Holiday | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | Observed on **Jan 2** (Monday) – gives a 3‑day weekend (Dec 31–Jan 2). |
| **Feb 20** (Monday) | Family Day | Provincial (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, Prince Edward Island, Newfoundland & Labrador). Gives a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Apr 7** (Friday) | Good Friday | Federal holiday – gives a 3‑day weekend (Apr 5–7). |
| **May 22** (Monday) | Victoria Day | Federal holiday – gives a 3‑day weekend (May 20–22). |
| **Jul 3** (Monday) | Canada Day (observed) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so it’s observed on **Jul 3** – gives a 3‑day weekend (Jul 1–3). |
| **Sep 4** (Monday) | Labour Day | Federal holiday – gives a 3‑day weekend (Sep 2–4). |
| **Oct 9** (Monday) | Thanksgiving | Federal holiday – gives a 3‑day weekend (Oct 7–9). |
| **Nov 11** (Monday) | Remembrance Day | Federal holiday – gives a 3‑day weekend (Nov 9–11). |
| **Dec 25** (Monday) | Christmas Day | Federal holiday – gives a 3‑day weekend (Dec 23–25). |
| **Dec 26** (Tuesday) | Boxing Day | Federal holiday – gives a 3‑day weekend (Dec 24–26). |

**Quick Takeaway:**  
- **12 federal holidays** in 2023 create long weekends (including the observed days).  
- **Family Day** is provincial, so the exact long weekend depends on your province.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
